purpose: Freeze Round 4 admissions, splits, and held-out gates before recomputing any verdict.

balanced_start.admitted_state: conservative exact face-transport restriction at t0
balanced_start.truth_fast_energy: report max hours 1-6 and mean hours 25-48 from the matching coarse-grained truth
balanced_start.ssh_tendency: report hours 1, 6, 24, and 48; no admission threshold

training_data.lineage: t0 is conservative snapshot day N; targets are right endpoints hours 1..96 of start_day N

deterministic_loss.primary: Maddison 2026 Eq. 7: 1e4/(beta^2 L^2)/(4 L^2)/M times sum over hourly squared Gaussian-filtered relative-vorticity error weighted by dx^2; boundary weight zero
deterministic_loss.rotational_velocity_terms: optional and disabled for experiment one

energy_score: Brolly 2026 Eqs. 9-10: per-lead Euclidean energy score, pair denominator 2*S*(S-1), uniform lead average, S>=2

reference_adequacy.early_pass: every field on every day 1..8 has normalized RMS <=0.10 and pattern correlation >=0.99
reference_adequacy.annual_pass: each year-1 relative difference <= max(0.10, 6.25-km year-to-year fractional variability)

evaluation.spectra: DST-I streamfunction KE spectrum and direct vorticity enstrophy spectrum
evaluation.grid_noise: RMS two-dimensional second difference divided by field RMS

stochastic_readiness: interface only; no stochastic rollout or stochastic claim in Round 4
